title: Generate public model release notes pages from changelog artifacts (plus RSS/JSON feeds)
author: Wei Chen
description: ## Summary This PR adds a docs build step that consumes generated changelog artifacts (from the model registry/control plane changelog generator) and renders versioned, customer-visible model release note pages in the docs site. It also produces an RSS feed and a machine-readable JSON feed for programmatic consumption. The goal is to make model/version promotions visible and consistent (Hosted/Dedicated/Private where applicable) while keeping internal-only details redacted and enforcing the taxonomy/style constraints defined for customer notes. ## Why We currently have model/version changes scattered across internal release processes and ad-hoc docs updates, which has led to customers seeing “silent” model updates and inconsistent guidance on what changed / what to do. This PR is one leg of the end-to-end pipeline: (1) metadata change events => (2) changelog generator artifact => (3) docs build consumes artifact => (4) published release notes pages and feeds. ## What’s included - Adds `scripts/release-notes/ingestChangelogArtifacts.ts` which downloads/reads changelog artifacts (local path in CI; optional remote URL via env var for preview builds), validates against `publicChangelogArtifact.schema.json`, and writes a normalized `generated/release-notes/models/*.json` index used by the site. - Adds page generation for: `/release-notes/models/:modelSlug/:version` (versioned page) and `/release-notes/models/:modelSlug` (model landing page with version timeline + filters). - Adds feed generation: `public/release-notes/models/rss.xml` and `public/release-notes/models/feed.json`. - Adds guardrails: fails build if any entry is marked `visibility=internal` or includes internal-only fields (defense-in-depth; the generator already filters, but docs should not trust inputs). - Adds canonical URLs + stable IDs for feed items (`modelSlug@semver` + published timestamp) to avoid duplication across builds. - Adds minimal “rollout context” rendering: when a note includes public rollout info (e.g., Hosted first, Dedicated next), the page displays it, but does not render account-specific targeting, regions, or internal policy rules. - Adds partial backfill support: can ingest a small set of historical artifacts to seed the index (no attempt to rewrite legacy freeform release notes). ## Non-goals - Customer notification subscriptions (email/webhook). - Rendering any private/embargoed changes. - Surfacing internal audit or SIEM export details (those remain in Console/Admin + audit logs). ## Implementation notes - Artifact format: expects the v1 public artifact output from the changelog generator (see `redwood` PR-18441 and `redwood-model-registry` PR-18421). We validate the artifact schema + enforce redaction checks. - Sorting: versions are sorted by `published_at` primarily; semver is used as a tie-breaker. - Feeds: RSS is “last 50 items” (configurable); JSON feed includes the same window. - SEO: adds `noindex` for drafts/preview builds; production build only publishes the generated pages. - Failure modes: build fails fast with a concise error message showing the offending entry ID and the field that violates public policy (e.g., `internal_notes`, `incident_id`, `customer_name`). ## Testing - Unit tests for ingestion + schema validation + redaction enforcement. - Snapshot tests for RSS and JSON feed outputs. - Local verification via `pnpm release-notes:mock` (creates a mock artifact in `./fixtures/changelog/`) and `pnpm dev` to confirm routing and page rendering. ## Rollout plan - Behind `PUBLIC_MODEL_RELEASE_NOTES=1` flag for staging. - After generator artifacts are available for at least one model family, we will enable in prod and add a top-level nav link (separate PR to avoid coupling IA changes). ## Screenshots/Examples (text) - Example URL: `/release-notes/models/llama-3-1-instruct/3.1.2` - Feed URL: `/release-notes/models/rss.xml` and `/release-notes/models/feed.json`
commits: docs(release-notes): ingest changelog artifacts and validate public schema
docs(release-notes): add model/version release notes pages and routing
docs(feeds): generate RSS and JSON feed for model release notes
docs(build): add CI step + env wiring for artifact source and preview builds
test(release-notes): add redaction and schema validation unit tests
review_conversation: Elliot Price: Can we guarantee we never publish internal-only fields even if the generator regresses? Also please add a human-friendly build error to help docs oncall triage.

Wei Chen (author): Added explicit denylist checks + schema validation in docs build. Error now prints entry ID + field name + remediation hint ("re-run generator with public filtering; check ENG-9825 redaction rules").
Kira Thompson: Private customers will ask whether these notes match upgrade bundles. Can we render “availability by deployment” clearly but without overpromising timelines?

Wei Chen (author): Rendered `availability` section only when present in public artifact and kept language factual ("Available in Hosted" / "Planned for Dedicated" if provided). No dates unless artifact includes an explicit public date.
Jada Williams: Please ensure stable IDs for feed entries; we had dupes previously when ordering changed. Also watch out for semver parsing with model variants like `-q4_k_m` suffixes.

Wei Chen (author): Feed IDs now use `model_slug + version + published_at` and we normalize version display separately from route param. Added tests covering variant suffixes and non-strict semver (we fallback to lexical + published_at).

Connor O'Brien: CI: I want this to run in preview builds but not block unrelated doc-only edits when PUBLIC_MODEL_RELEASE_NOTES=0. Also add an explicit artifact freshness warning if source is missing.

Wei Chen (author): Workflow now runs ingestion only when flag is enabled (staging/prod). For preview builds, it uses fixtures unless `CHANGELOG_ARTIFACT_URL` is set. If missing in prod/staging, build fails with a clear message and points to the producing job.
Elliot Price: Approved after the redaction tests landed.
release_notes: Docs site can now publish per-model, per-version release notes from generated changelog artifacts.
Added public RSS and JSON feeds for model release notes.
Build-time validation prevents internal-only fields from being published.
security_considerations: Docs build enforces public-only schema + explicit denylist checks to prevent leakage of internal notes, customer identifiers, incident references, or rollout policy internals. Production build fails closed if a violating field is detected.
follow_ups: Add top-level nav entry and docs IA updates (tracked in PM-412 follow-up).
Coordinate enablement timing with changelog artifact production in `redwood` (ENG-9823) and CI preview checks (ENG-9826).
Add a small curated backfill set once final taxonomy/style guide lands (see PR-9320).
